description: Median symbolic melody statistics of real, human-labelled reference recordings, measured by tools/judge/melody-stats.mjs. Derived statistics only - no source audio or MIDI is redistributed.

caveats.detection: Melody detection is a heuristic (monophony plus register), not ground truth. On a handful of references it picks a doubling or a counter-line instead of the vocal/lead part; the eight-file median resists this, but any single file's row can mislead if read on its own.
caveats.impliedThird: The implied-third clause in melChordTone/melStrongChordTone credits a minor or major third above the lowest sounding accompaniment note only when the accompaniment carries no third of its own - the power-chord case (root+fifth). Once a triad sounds, only its real pitch classes count, so a wrong-quality third is not credited. It remains an approximation over an inverted or fourth-shaped bed, where the lowest sounding note is not the harmonic root and the implied-third test targets the wrong pitch classes.
caveats.quantisation: The corpus is quantised, step-sequenced transcriptions, not performance captures. Pitch-relationship metrics (chord tone, clash, step, leap) survive this fine; nothing in this file measures timing feel or ornamentation - see groove-reference.json's own caveats for why that distinction matters on the rhythm side.
caveats.barLeapSplit: An attempt to split melLeap into 'within the bar' vs 'across the bar line' gave contradictory results between two measuring tools on this corpus and is deliberately NOT included as a metric here.
